hints: After reflection in the $x$-axis, the intermediate curve is $y = -\sin x$, with amplitude 1 and midline $y=0$.
Compare the target curve $y=f(x)$ which has amplitude 3 (ranging between $-5$ and $1$) and midline $y = -2$.
Describe the vertical stretch by scale factor 3 (parallel to the $y$-axis) and the translation by vector $\begin{pmatrix}0\\-2\end{pmatrix}$.
walkthrough:
Analyze the properties of the target curve $y=f(x)$ from the diagram:
$$\text{Maximum value } = 1, \quad \text{Minimum value } = -5$$
$$\text{Amplitude} = \frac{1 - (-5)}{2} = 3, \quad \text{Midline} = \frac{1 + (-5)}{2} = -2$$

Identify the first required transformation after reflection in the $x$-axis (which gives $y = -\sin x$):
$$\text{Stretch with scale factor } 3 \text{ in the } y\text{-direction (parallel to the } y\text{-axis), giving } y = -3\sin x$$

Identify the second required transformation to shift the midline from $y = 0$ to $y = -2$:
$$\text{Translation by vector } \begin{pmatrix} 0 \\ -2 \end{pmatrix} \text{ (or } 2 \text{ units in the negative } y\text{-direction), giving } y = -3\sin x - 2$$

ai_rubric.Writing Equations After Graph Transforma: Describes a vertical stretch with scale factor 3 in the $y$-direction (B2). Describes a translation by vector $\begin{pmatrix}0\\-2\end{pmatrix}$ (B2).

hints: Combine the reflection in the $x$-axis, vertical stretch by factor 3, and downward shift by 2.
walkthrough:
Apply the full sequence of transformations to $y = \sin x$:
$$\text{Reflection in } x\text{-axis: } y = -\sin x$$
$$\text{Stretch by factor } 3 \text{ in } y\text{-direction: } y = -3\sin x$$
$$\text{Translation by } \begin{pmatrix}0\\-2\end{pmatrix}: y = -3\sin x - 2$$

State the resulting expression for $f(x)$:
$$f(x) = -3\sin x - 2$$

ai_rubric.Writing Equations After Graph Transforma: States $f(x) = -3\sin x - 2$ (B2, award B1 for $-3\sin x$ and B1 for $-2$).
